goal: Materialize the existing J-Quants research features into the live Supabase production read model and current Research Workspace v2. Production means Supabase tables/migrations/RPCs or Edge Functions; local Parquet and SQLite must not be the final destination. From existing jq_market_price_daily rows, create a dedicated ex-post outcomes dataset with 1/5/20/60 trading-day forward returns and benchmark-relative excess returns. Keep outcomes separate from PIT features to prevent look-ahead leakage; use adjusted prices, deterministic trading-session alignment, null tails when future sessions are unavailable, and no new provider calls. Backfill and refresh must be idempotent, bounded, incremental, resumable, indexed, and provenance-aware. Connect existing shareholder-benefit/total-yield logic to the live jq_market_yield production publication path, populating investable capital, annual benefit value, benefit yield and total yield only when reliable evidence exists; otherwise preserve unknown state. Expose useful fields through the active Workspace v2/API and metric catalog, not only legacy/local APIs. Add tests/audits for coverage, nulls, benchmark alignment, idempotency and PIT leakage. Preserve all current quota safeguards, request reserves, atomic publication and CI. Do not add unrelated data categories or unbounded fetching.
